name: Knowlify
long_description:
Knowlify is a done-for-you video ads agency for startups running paid social. We write the ads and make them: UGC-style talking-head, commercials, and Pixar-style. You brief us on a 20-minute call. We send the direction in writing, you approve it, and the first finished batch lands in days. New ads come every week, ready to upload.

If you have been prompting an AI video tool and getting back something that is not the ad you asked for, that is the job we take. You wrote the prompt. You still do not have an ad. You wrote the brief. The tool ignored it. You do not write another prompt. You approve the direction, and we make the ads.

Startups use Knowlify when they need more creative to test than an agency round, a creator roster, or a prompt box can ship. We produce the videos. Media spend stays yours.
one_liner: DFY video paid ads agency for startups
